description: Runs a smell-first audit on a user-chosen path set: measures structure metrics, applies a named size profile, and reports code smells and test smells with evidence strength. Use for smell audit, code smell scan, whole-repo audit, tech debt scan, test smell check, maintainability audit, or duplication and nesting checks. Do not use for PR review, merge advice, implementing fixes, writing new features, or lint/format-only passes.
